product_summary: Live company website (https://www.rotolock.in/, accessed via http_get) lists four product lines: (1) Rotary Air Lock Valve / Rotary Valve / Rotary Feeder; (2) CI Slide Gate Valve; (3) Dampers & Diverters; (4) Screw Conveyors. Site states founding 2006, plant at Plot No.178/1, Sector 7, P.C.N.T.D.A., MIDC, Bhosari, Pune 411 026, and describes itself as manufacturer of 'industrial flow control and material handling equipment'. Declared industries served: Chemical & Petrochemical, Construction, Heavy Engineering, Oil & Gas, Power Generation, Pharmaceutical, Refrigeration, Steel & Metals. Note: the homepage also carries a block for 'Suprash Engineering Works' (main gates, roofings, furniture, sheet metal fabrication, water tankers & containers, automobile base components supplied to Tata Motors / Force Motors) — this appears to be a related/predecessor entity, not the declared product line, and is NOT covered by the declared HS code.
comment: HS 848180 ('taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances') is a PARTIAL match: it correctly covers the valve lines (Rotary Air Lock Valve, CI Slide Gate Valve) and plausibly the dampers/diverter valves. It does NOT cover the non-valve lines on the same site: Screw Conveyors (bulk-material conveying) fall under HS 8428 (continuous-action conveyors, e.g. 8428.39) and rotary airlock/rotary feeder units used as feeding/discharge devices are frequently classified as 8481.80 or as machinery parts 8479.89 depending on function — the site gives no technical specification, so the exact subheading cannot be verified. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas, chemicals) is only partially representative: the site lists 8 served sectors, of which oil & gas and chemical/petrochemical are two; the company is a general industrial flow-control and bulk-material-handling fabricator, not an oil & gas specialist. Trader signs: none found — the site explicitly claims in-house design and manufacturing with lathes, drilling machines and welding inverters, and no third-party brands or resale catalogue are presented, so role is manufacturer. No customs line, shipping bill or export document was reviewed in this task (out of scope), therefore all product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — the only source is the company's own website; no independent corroboration of actual shipments was checked here. Recommended action per Rule 3: keep the company, retain 848180 as primary, and add 8428.39 (screw conveyors) plus a note that rotary feeders/airlocks may fall under 8479.89 pending technical datasheet; verdict accepted_hs_corrected rather than rejected. Sub-pages (/products, /products.html, /rotary-air-lock-valve.html) returned HTTP 404, so no detailed model/spec data could be read; no revenue, CIN, PAN or shipment data researched per role scope.
